# Anvil

> Anvil is an open source family of developer tools: a desktop app for agent workflows on your own repos, an npm gateway enforcing deterministic install policy, a hardened Node base image, and a portable app runtime — plus an account layer (Sync & Mesh) that keeps a user's own machines in step with end-to-end encrypted replication.

The public documentation is organized by product and by task: Learn, Build, and Reference. Product status and limits are part of the documentation; do not infer production readiness from alpha surfaces.

## Start here

- [Documentation index](/docs): Search or choose a product and task path.
- [Anvil overview](/docs/overview): Understand the product boundaries.
- [Repository map](/docs/project/repositories): See which workspace owns each surface.
- [Open source project](/docs/project/open-source): Read the project and contribution model.

## Products

- [Anvil Desktop](/docs/desktop): Desktop app for agent workflows on your repos.
- [Anvil Registry](/docs/registry): npm dependency ingress and deterministic policy.
- [Anvil Node Base](/docs/node-base): Safer and observed Node dependency installs.
- [Anvil Cloud](/docs/cloud): Anvil Cells, Agents, runtime contracts, and deployment adapters.

## Sync & Mesh (account layer)

- [Sync & Mesh overview](/docs/sync/overview): Sealed sync across a user's own devices, mesh jobs on their machines, backend of their choice.
- [Encryption and keys](/docs/sync/encryption): AES-256-GCM envelopes under a versioned account key; the backend sees shape, not content.
- [Devices and pairing](/docs/sync/devices): X25519 device identities enrolled through single-use pair codes.
- [Mesh jobs](/docs/sync/mesh-jobs): Dispatch work to enrolled machines; compute and credentials stay on the user's hardware.
- [Session handoff](/docs/sync/session-handoff): Move a running session between devices through sealed checkpoints.
- [Self-deploy the backend](/docs/sync/self-deploy): Run the same Sync v1 worker on your own Cloudflare account.
- [Hosted sync](/docs/sync/hosted): The Anvil-operated backend — free through 31 October 2026, paid plan from 1 November 2026.
- [Status and limits](/docs/sync/status-and-limits): What is proven, what is still pending.
